Dear Hiring Manager,

I'm writing to apply for the Email & Campaign Specialist role at Maasmechelen Village. Your focus on turning commercial inputs into campaigns that convert and feel premium across email, push, and mobile wallet is exactly the kind of work I do best.

At Episto, I run Google Ads Search campaigns and chose buyer-intent keywords that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks in a self-funded test for a kids' bike brand. I also built ~600 member profile pages on one consistent layout for a pharmacists' association, and I track KPIs in GA4 and Search Console to steer what comes next. I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level.

I have my own car, so the daily trip to your Brussels office is no problem. In the first weeks, I'd map your campaign calendar and build a welcome flow that feels personal from the first send. I'd welcome a conversation about how I can help drive Village footfall.

Baver Ok

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your posting for an Email & Campaign Specialist at Maasmechelen Village asks for someone who can turn a mix of promotions, brand activations, and seasonal moments into one clear plan that converts and feels premium. That's the work I've been doing: at Episto, I ran a self-funded Google Ads test for a kids' bike brand, chose buyer-intent keywords, and earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks. I also built ~600 member profile pages on one consistent layout for a pharmacists' association, and I track rankings, traffic, and CTR in GA4 and Search Console to steer what comes next.

What draws me to Maasmechelen Village is the end-to-end ownership: planning, building, and optimising behaviour-triggered flows like welcome, birthday, and lapsing, then using performance data to shape the next campaign. I've done that kind of synthesis as a freelancer, bringing in a construction company through a referral, leading the discovery meeting, and building a full growth proposal covering website, Google Business Profile, regional Google Ads, and social media. I'm comfortable working independently and enjoy the execution as much as the strategy.

I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level. I have my own car, so the daily trip to your Brussels office is no problem.

In the first weeks, I'd map your campaign calendar and build a welcome flow that feels personal from the first send, then report on open rates and CTR to refine targeting. I'd welcome a conversation about how I can help drive Village footfall.

Baver Ok

# Baver Ok
Digital Marketer · Google Ads & SEO · Campaign Analytics · AI Automation
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | [+32 470 42 48 36](tel:+32470424836) | [baverok@gmail.com](mailto:baverok@gmail.com)
[linkedin.com/in/baverok](https://www.linkedin.com/in/baverok) | [baverok.com](https://baverok.com) | 02-04-1994
English (fluent) · Turkish (native) · Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+)

## SUMMARY
I am a digital marketer with a sales mindset, judging every campaign by the customers it brings in. I plan, build and optimise campaigns end-to-end, from keyword research and landing pages to Google Ads and performance reporting in GA4 and Search Console. I have run self-funded Google Ads tests with 4.57% CTR, supported a WooCommerce webshop with conversion pages, and built marketing automation tools with AI. I am analytical, follow algorithm updates closely, and want a commercial team where ownership turns into more customers.

## PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

### Junior Digital Marketer – Episto (Remote), 03/2026 – Present
- Support a WooCommerce e-commerce webshop ([proteinbox.com.tr](https://proteinbox.com.tr)) with catalogue, product content and conversion pages
- Track KPIs (rankings, traffic, CTR) in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console and report on results
- Run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients
- **#4 on page 1** of Google Turkey for "PDKS" (access-control software), as part of the agency team

### Freelance Digital Marketer – [baverok.com](https://baverok.com), 09/2026 – Present
- **4.57% CTR and 53 clicks** from a self-funded Google Ads test in Belgium and the Netherlands for a kids' bike brand: built two Dutch landing pages, chose buyer-intent keywords and presented the results to their team
- Sell AI search visibility, SEO, website and marketing automation services, with a free site check as the first step in each sales conversation
- Brought in a construction company through a referral, led the discovery meeting and built a full growth proposal covering the website, Google Business Profile, regional Google Ads and social media

### Web & SEO Specialist – Knowledge Experts ([KXP](https://kxp.be)), 01/2024 – 02/2026
- Analysed SEO performance and reported results to clients with Search Console and Google Analytics
- Built [kxp.be](https://kxp.be) single-handedly: WordPress, on-page SEO, GEO for AI search, in English, Dutch and French
- Delivered client websites end to end, from site structure and content to social media integration
- **#3 on Google** for "Belgian chess prodigy" with [mirook.com](https://mirook.com), a young chess player's personal-brand site, through technical SEO audits and schema markup

## PROJECTS & PRODUCTS

### AI job-search assistant
- Built an AI tool that collects job postings from VDAB, LinkedIn and EURES, scores each one for fit and drafts a tailored CV and cover letter, as a working example of marketing automation

### PupSmart – AI dog-care app on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.momoco.pupsmart)
- Designed, built and launched an Android app with a potty predictor, a toxic-food scanner and AI health insights based on each dog's 7-day activity log
- Published it under my own label, MomoCo: free with ads, with premium AI features for subscribers

## SKILLS
- **Growth & sales:** landing pages, A/B testing, lead generation, client discovery meetings, offers and proposals
- **SEO & marketing:** Google Ads Search, SEO strategy, keyword research, on-page, technical, local and mobile SEO, link building, SEO audits, schema markup, AI search (GEO/AEO), content marketing, WooCommerce
- **Data & tools:** GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Microsoft Clarity, WordPress/Elementor, HTML/CSS, Odoo, Canva, Claude/ChatGPT

## EDUCATION
- Applied Computer Science (coursework) – Karel de Grote Hogeschool, Antwerp, 2022 – 2025
- Computer Science (coursework) – Celal Bayar University, Türkiye, 2012 – 2016
